newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary electricity works Elmu taps markets.
newsitem.headline: Hungary electricity works Elmu taps markets.

text.p: Hungary's Budapest Electricity Works (Elmu Rt) has placed privately discount notes worth one billion forints in face value as part of its three billion forints note issuance programme, arranger WestLB Investment (Magyarorszag) Rt said in a statement on Thursday.
The first series has a maturity of six months while maturities of the further tranches may run from seven days to five years. The note issues aim at general corporate finance purposes.
Elmu distributes electricity to the Hungarian capital and its shares are traded on the over-the-counter market.
